# dr_libs

Single-file audio decoders (`dr_flac.h`, `dr_wav.h`, `dr_mp3.h`) from
https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs at commit `a9b46d4d91117636015e75e09761299aa1f4283f`,
unmodified. Public domain or MIT No Attribution, see `LICENSE`.

Used only by `src/tools/projectm-render`; the library does not decode audio.
